title: Portal Gates
subtitle: Build a frame, power it, jump
text:
Build a rectangle of frame blocks standing upright, with the Portal Gate Controller as one of its blocks. The inside must be empty, at least 2 wide and 3 tall.

Frames: Iron, Steel or Titanium blocks (Netherite if the server allows it). Wood and other blocks do not form a gate. Some worlds need a better frame. Bigger frames need more power to open.

The controller takes HV power only, from HV cables, the HV side of a transformer or an HV relay. LV or MV power browns it out: it sparks, loses some of its stored energy and will not open. Any LV or MV cable touching it burns out and can start a fire. A generator placed right against it browns it out too. Step power up with transformers first.

Put an Entangled Core and a card in it, and Entangled Pellets for fuel. Each jump uses pellets and a lot of energy; rich, high tier worlds cost more. Press Open and walk through. A return rift opens where you land: walk into it to come home.

On some servers the gate is run by the story. It has no card slot and only needs pellets and power; the destination is set for you. There the gate travels with a ship between star systems. Each world it opens to is a planet of the system the ship is in, and it stays the same planet every time you go back, until the ship moves on. Then those planets are gone for good. While the ship is between systems the gate shows In transit and will not open.

A gate belongs to whoever placed it, like an entangled code. It starts public. Its owner can make it private with a screwdriver: then only they can open its screen, change its card, open or close it and drop its rift. Hoppers cannot put cards into a private gate. Anyone can still walk through an open gate or rift.
